response.text:
Here is what falls in October 2026, soonest first.

**Deadlines**
- Return the overdue library items (Stadtbibliothek), due Fri 2 Oct 2026 [item:itm_ghq58jjdz149]. Fees keep increasing until then, and the account gets blocked for loans at a limit.
- Objection to the Muster BKK contribution notice (optional), due Wed 14 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. Ordnung suggests sending it by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [item:itm_tj3z83ve4hfg]. An objection does not suspend payment.
- Cancel the mobile contract FunkNetz Smart M: it must arrive by Wed 14 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]. Post it by Thu 8 Oct 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2]. The current term ends on Sat 14 Nov 2026 [contract:ctr_fyt9k994t9q2].
- Cancel the Ausländerbehörde appointment if you can't attend, due Mon 19 Oct 2026 [item:itm_jr5r71kc1r78].
- Objection (Einspruch) to the Finanzamt Musterstadt assessment, due Wed 21 Oct 2026 [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a]. Ordnung suggests sending it by Thu 15 Oct 2026 [item:itm_mtehckcf6q7a].

**Payments**
- Parking warning fee, due Fri 2 Oct 2026: 30.00 € [item:itm_31yxpwg03cdb]. The amount was read from a scan, so check it against the paper letter.
- Monthly rent, due Mon 5 Oct 2026: 640.00 € [item:itm_b1b5643x7qy7].
- Additional operating costs, due Fri 9 Oct 2026: 184.30 € [item:itm_dmaw27qvv18n].
- Residence permit extension fee, paid by girocard at the appointment on Wed 14 Oct 2026: 100.00 € [item:itm_wj2v05avgk1m].
- Electricity advance, collected by direct debit on Thu 15 Oct 2026: 48.00 € [item:itm_kttk9625293w].
- Health and care insurance contribution, collected by direct debit on Thu 15 Oct 2026: 156.55 € [item:itm_00sbt9f3e0pe].

**Appointments**
- Dental check-up and cleaning, Thu 8 Oct 2026 at 09:15 [item:itm_tt8cexs1k1tw].
- Residence permit extension appointment, Wed 14 Oct 2026 at 10:30 [item:itm_64wce6sh2rpp]. Bring all the listed original documents.

If you disagree with the tax assessment or the insurance notice, you may want to get advice before the objection deadlines. You can mark items done or draft letters in Ordnung.
